handshake.note: wire.rs sends serverInfo first with PROTOCOL_VERSION 1 and the three required capabilities, so this should pass; never measured against the suite.

create.note: conn.rs sends `created` but no following `attached`, so a client learns the session exists without ever being told it is attached and gets no scrollback baseline.

create-guards.note: the unknown-provider error reads "unknown provider: x" (lowercase) and there is no is-a-directory guard on cwd, so a doomed spawn replaces the clear error.

attach-scrollback.note: attach replays registry scrollback; the meta and status fields on `attached.session` are unverified.

input-ack.note: input/inputAck with seq is implemented; ordering under load and the no-seq-no-ack rule are unverified.

resize.note: no grid arbitration: resizeAck always reports denied:false, so a second viewer silently fights the first for the pty grid.

screen-stream.note: screen streaming exists (alacritty_terminal + screen.rs); reset-on-alt-flip, cursor visibility and stop-on-unsubscribe are unverified.

activity-notify.note: conn.rs derives notify as `state == Idle`, so a waiting_input prompt never notifies and a prompt that cleared itself notifies again. The Swift core notifies on the turn boundary AND on a prompt, and stays quiet when a prompt clears.

activity-changes.note: no settle-edge change rollup: the activity frame carries no `changes`, so a remote client cannot badge "finished, N files changed".

queue.note: no `queue` capability: subscribeQueue / queueMessage / dequeueMessage decode to Unknown and are ignored.

exit-codes.note: exit is emitted; the -1-on-signal convention and the attach-then-exit replay for a dead session are unverified.

unresumable.note: `reactivate` is decoded as `attach`, so reviving a dead session cannot report unresumable; and an unknown session id answers `unresumable` where the Swift core answers `error: Session not found`.

errors.note: attach of an unknown session answers `unresumable` rather than `error`, and setSkipPermissions / subscribeScreen error texts do not exist yet.

tracked-prs.note: no `trackedPrs` capability: the tracked-PR registry, its poll loop and its fan-out are not ported.

editor-terminal.note: no `editor` / `terminal` capability: there are no ephemeral ptys, so openEditor / openTerminal are ignored.

adopt-external.note: the capability list advertises `adoptExternal` but ClientMessage has no AdoptExternal variant, so the frame decodes to Unknown and is silently dropped. Advertising a capability the core does not implement is worse than omitting it: feature detection is exactly what clients trust.

dispatch-correlation.note: create accepts dispatchId but activity frames hard-code dispatch_id: None, and there is no dispatch ledger, so a repeat dispatch is started twice instead of rejected.

skip-permissions.note: setSkipPermissions is not decoded, so the permission mode of a live session cannot be changed.
